data.name: Ruma
data.gender_notes: Ruma is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ruma is an Arabic name that refers to a companion or a friend. In Islamic tradition, it is used to describe a close associate of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). The name Ruma carries the meaning “Companion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ruma usually hope their child will grow to embody companion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who is a constant companion on the path of righteousness.
data.etymology: Ruma belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Companion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ruma total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: روما
in_arabic.meaning: روما اسم يعني رومة او روماني الأصل
in_arabic.long_meaning: روما هو اسم علم مؤنث من أصل روماني، وقد ورد ذكره في بعض المراجع الإسلامية، ويعني الشخص الذي يحمل الجنسية الرومانية أو الشخص الذي يتبع الثقافة الرومانية، وقد استخدم هذا الاسم في بعض الدول الإسلامية للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يمتلك أصول رومانية أو ثقافية رومانية.

in_urdu.name: روما
in_urdu.meaning: روما کا مطلب ہے روم سے تعلق رکھنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: روما ایک علم اسم ہے جو روم سے تعلق رکھنے والے شخص کے لئے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے، یہ نام رومانی ثقافت اور تہذیب سے جڑا ہوا ہے، اور اسلامی دنیا میں بھی اس کا استعمال کیا جاتا ہے، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیا میں، جہاں رومانی ثقافت کا اثر کم ہے لیکن اسلامی تراثم اور ثقافت غالب ہے.

in_hindi.name: रोमा
in_hindi.meaning: रोमा का अर्थ है रोमन मूल का
in_hindi.long_meaning: रोमा एक ऐसा नाम है जो रोमन मूल के व्यक्ति के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है, यह नाम रोमन संस्कृति और सभ्यता से जुड़ा हुआ है, और भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी इसका उपयोग किया जाता है, जहां यह नाम पश्चिमी प्रभावों और इस्लामी परंपरा के मेल का प्रतीक हो सकता है.

in_pashto.name: روما
in_pashto.meaning: روما د روم څخه د تړاو لرونکی معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: روما یو علمي نوم دی چې د روم څخه د تړاو لرونکي کس لپاره کارول کیږي، دا نوم د روماني کلتور او تمدن سره تړلی دی، او د افغانستان او پښتونستان په اسلامي دود کې هم کارول کیږي، چیرته چې دا نوم د ثقافتي او تاريخي پلوه د پام وړ دی.

in_english.name: Ruma
in_english.meaning: Ruma means belonging to Rome or Roman origin
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ruma is derived from the Arabic root 'Rūm', which refers to the Romans or the Eastern Roman Empire, also known as the Byzantine Empire, in Islamic history and Quranic context, particularly mentioned in Surah Al-Rum, the 30th chapter of the Quran, signifying a connection to the Roman civilization and its cultural and historical impact on Islamic tradition and identity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ruma holds cultural significance as it is a reminder of the close companions and supporters of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) during his lifetime. These companions, known as the Sahabah, played a crucial role in the spread of Islam and the establishment of the early Islamic community. Ruma symbolizes the importance of companionship, loyalty, and unity within the Muslim community, emphasizing the role that strong relationships can play in the propagation of the faith.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Ruma holds a deeper significance as it represents a connection to the companions of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), who were devoted followers and shining examples of faith and righteousness. The name serves as a reminder to strive for closeness and companionship with Allah, and to be a true friend and companion to others, especially to those in need. Ruma is also a name of love and compassion, urging us to be kind and supportive to those around us in our daily lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Companion" symbolizes Ruma is an Arabic name that refers to a companion or a friend. historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ruma was a wife of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and the mother of his son Ibrahim. The name Ruma carried significant weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Ruma remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
